name: What size garbage disposal do I need for my kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What size garbage disposal do I need for my kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: The size of garbage disposal you need depends on your household's waste habits and the size of your family. Standard disposals range from 1/3 HP to 1 HP. Smaller households or those with light food waste might manage with 1/2 HP, while larger families or those who dispose of more fibrous foods benefit from 3/4 HP or 1 HP units. A practical tradeoff is balancing motor power with noise level; higher HP models tend to be quieter and more efficient but can be more expensive.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose based on household size and waste habits; 1/2 HP for light use, 3/4 HP or 1 HP for heavier use. Higher HP offers more power and quiet operation.
